title: Chapter 207: Gaining A Foothold In The Underground World
content:
Chapter 207: Gaining A Foothold In The Underground World

After the Zerg built a defense circle in the underground world, the Zerg army began to advance and continue to expand the occupied territory. No matter how many ghouls rushed up, they could not break through the multi-level firepower network of the Zerg army.

The Queen of Zerg controls the Zerg army to fight and can control the firepower output of the Zerg army in real time.

If the firepower is too strong, it will be weakened, and if the firepower is insufficient, it will be strengthened. It can always achieve the best killing effect with the least output.

The Zerg army continues to advance forward, and their combat formations continue to adjust to adapt to the ever-expanding front.

A large number of Zerg worker bees hatched, followed closely behind the Zerg army, built defensive buildings, and completely incorporated the territory conquered by the Zerg army into the Zerg territory.

As the Zerg army continued to advance, the territory occupied by the Zerg in the underground world became larger and larger, and the front line between the Zerg and the ghouls became longer and longer. The Zerg main force of less than 200,000 troops seemed a little insufficient.

This is a problem that the Zerg will inevitably face after expanding its territory. The main combat forces of the Zerg are constrained by resources, and their strength cannot be increased indefinitely.

When the Zerg territory expands to a certain extent, the task of the main combat forces of the Zerg will change from seizing territory to positional annihilation war. They will fight in any way that can effectively eliminate the living forces of the ghouls.

Now the active offensiveness of the ghouls is very strong, and the Zerg army can wait for the opportunity to fight the ghouls in the Zerg territory.

In the case of insufficient manpower of the main combat forces of the Zerg, this advantage should be utilized.

The Zerg temporarily maintains the current territory and attracts the ghouls to attack with all their strength, mainly to annihilate the living forces of the ghouls.

The territory occupied by the Zerg in the underground world is not small. The areas near the underground world barrier have fallen into the hands of the Zerg, which can be regarded as having a certain depth and can better protect the connection between the Zerg territory and the underground world.

Another large number of Zerg puppies entered the underground world. The Zerg's territory expanded and the battle line lengthened. The Zerg's main combat force is now close to the limit state, and the Zerg puppies are needed to reinforce at any time to deal with unexpected situations.

As the Zerg worker bees built the outermost defense circle, a half-moon Zerg base close to the underground world barrier was officially built and stabilized.

The Zerg's conquest in the underground world will be a long-term task. The Zerg needs to continue to accumulate strength and strive to take over the entire territory of the ghoul clan as soon as possible.

By defeating the ghoul clan, the obstacle, the Zerg can occupy a place in the underground world and officially step onto the mysterious stage of the underground world.

...

The Zerg's battle cannot stop, and Wu Qing implemented this guiding ideology very thoroughly.

The Zerg army's battles in the territory of the bear goblin clan, the territory of the Naga clan, and the underground world are carried out simultaneously and will continue until their respective predetermined goals are achieved.

The battle in the underground world can continue at night as long as the ghouls are willing, but as long as the ghouls are not stupid, the Zerg's easy annihilation war will not last long.

At that time, the Zerg army will need to take the initiative to attack. The Zerg's fighting process is the accumulation of Zerg's strength. The Zerg will become stronger and stronger, so this battle must not stop.

The Zerg defeated the bear goblins and now has a certain strength. The Tengu branch in this area is no longer a concern.

What Wu Qing needs is an opportunity. When he finds an opportunity, he must drive the Tengu forces out of this area. The Tengu are really annoying.

The power of the bear goblins in this area has been broken by the Zerg battle. It is only a matter of time before they are completely eliminated, which is also not a concern.

The Zerg can occupy their territory openly, which is already a matter of suspense.

Unless the unwilling bear goblins send a strong army to get back their place.

The Naga tribe is now an ally and is relatively friendly to the Zerg.

The Zerg can move freely in the spheres of influence of these three tribes. Only the Demon tribe needs a big war to completely defeat them.

The surrounding areas where the Zerg are located are mainly the spheres of influence of these four major tribes, which belong to two camps and have been in long-term confrontation.

The Zerg, the fifth largest force that suddenly emerged, has an advantage in combat power, but it is still very lacking in intelligence. It does not even have a decent map of the surrounding areas.

This makes Wu Qing, who is used to using system maps, a little unbearable. Now that all conditions are met, Wu Qing is ready to send a large number of Zerg hosts to explore this area and let the Queen of Zerg make a detailed map.

It only takes 100 energy to hatch a Zerg host, which is very little for the current Zerg, and a large number of hatches can be hatched.

Ordinary Zerg hosts, after being upgraded to the mother nest in the form of a beast cave, have a very fast flight speed and a very long detection distance. They can obtain information from a large area by flying over from the air. They are the best exploration and reconnaissance troops of the Zerg.

In addition, they have strong spiritual power and invisibility, and have a certain self-protection ability. Ordinary creatures cannot detect their existence, which makes their safety very guaranteed.

Wu Qing plans to use a large number of Zerg hosts to conduct a comprehensive exploration of the area where the Zerg is located, collect various information, draw maps, and establish an information database.

With these data, Wu Qing can make more in-depth plans.

Wu Qing immediately hatched a large number of Zerg hosts in the Zerg territory and sent them out.

These Zerg hosts that perform exploration and reconnaissance missions do not need to return to the Zerg territory at night, but find other territories nearby to rest. As long as they are careful, others will not find them.

This will greatly improve the exploration and reconnaissance efficiency of the Zerg hosts.

As for the safety of the Zerg hosts, Wu Qing is not worried.

It doesn't matter if they are discovered. The Zerg hosts have the ability to communicate. The Tengu tribe dare not attack them, the Naga tribe will not attack them, and if the Bear Goblins and Demons are really bad for them, the Queen can come and give the enemy something cruel.

The death of the Zerg host is just a loss of a little energy. They will turn into light and disappear. The enemy will get nothing, and the impact is not great.

With the exploration and reconnaissance of these Zerg hosts, it won't take much time for Wu Qing to know this area well.

This is the preliminary preparation for the Zerg to control this area.

...

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the body, walked out of the Zerg mother nest, walked around, exercised his body, and stretched his muscles.

He has arranged the important things, and the rest can be left to the Queen.

Although the Zerg army is now fighting in three places at the same time, there are two pioneering and exploring teams, the Silkworm Knights and the Zerg Hosts, and the city is under construction, but Wu Qing does not need to pay attention to these personally.

If there is any problem, the Queen will notify him in time.

Wu Qing now has to deal with the problem of his original strength. The strength of the original body is too weak, which will also have a certain impact on the clone.

With the continuous development of the Zerg, the population of Daxia Territory has increased rapidly. In addition, the recovery of the territories and cities occupied by the bear goblins, the construction of new cities, and the reputation outside, the basic luck of Daxia Territory has increased significantly.

When the basic luck of Daxia Territory is enough, even if there is no luck for the lord to use, Wu Qing can also use the basic luck of the territory to improve his strength.

The development and growth of the territory is the credit of the lord. Among the basic luck of the territory, there is also a part that belongs to the lord. Although it is not used, it can help the lord break through the bottleneck of strength.

Wu Qing calmed down and started to practice the body-refining boxing. With his original strength level and perfect cultivation qualifications, as long as the world rules do not deliberately suppress him, it will be easy for him to break through the star level.

Before a set of body-refining boxing was finished, Wu Qing's strength was successfully upgraded to two stars. He did not feel anything special when he had such strength again.

It was just that the amount of essence, qi, and spirit increased, allowing Wu Qing to exert more strength.

After a set of body-refining boxing, Wu Qing felt that the two-star strength was still too weak. Now that the qi resources were sufficient, he took out a part of the system's increasing qi resources and converted it into the luck of Daxia Territory.

When he felt that Daxia Territory's luck was enough for his strength to break through to three stars, he stopped the conversion of luck.

With enough luck support, Wu Qing continued to practice body-refining boxing.

Wu Qing's body continued to adapt to the strength of two stars, and he soared forward all the way without any obstacles. His strength soon broke through to three stars.

The amount of essence, qi, and spirit of three-star strength has been greatly improved, but there has been no qualitative change.

According to Wu Qing's understanding of the level of strength, from one star to nine stars, there will be no qualitative change in essence, qi, and spirit.

When the strength is upgraded from three stars to four stars, and from six stars to seven stars, the essence, qi, and spirit will have a quantitative change to qualitative change, but this is not a qualitative change.

In the current system-affiliated world, three stars are upgraded to four stars, and six stars are upgraded to seven stars. These are two small bottlenecks in cultivation. Many people with low cultivation qualifications are easily stuck in such bottlenecks.

It seems that these two bottlenecks exist in this world because of the luck, but they are not particularly obvious.

Wu Qing now has very limited information, and some things are not well understood, and further exploration is needed.

Wu Qing's body, which has three-star strength, can be said to be invincible at the three-star strength level. He thinks that he can also fight against four-star and five-star opponents.

However, with the Zerg, his body no longer needs to fight in person.

Wu Qing does not have the three-star melee arms of the Zerg around him. He can only use the biological colonization suit to transform various weapons, practice alone, and adapt to the strength he has regained.

As long as Daxia has enough luck, Wu Qing's strength can continue to improve. Now the strongest Zerg soldiers are all three-star, so there is no need for Wu Qing to continue to improve his strength.

Wu Qing stopped there.
